news.headline: Israel: Netanyahu and Eisenkot both pledge to form government
news.summary:
🗳️ Both Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin #Netanyahu and rival Gadi #Eisenkot pledged to form a government as the two are projected to finish neck and neck in #Israel's critical election Tuesday. 
 
Exit polls show both blocs falling short of a parliamentary majority.
